have key : ∀ a b (t : a.Sublist b), List.Sublist.below t ∧ motive a b t := by intro a b t; induction t with | slnil => exact ⟨.slnil, F _ _ _ .slnil⟩ | cons x h ih => exact ⟨.cons x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩ | cons₂ x h ih => exact ⟨.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩
have key : ∀ a b (t : a.Sublist b), List.Sublist.below t ∧ motive a b t := by intro a b t; induction t <;> refine ⟨?_, F _ _ _ ?_⟩ <;> constructor <;> (try assumption) <;> simp_all
